name: Gakuen ~Chijoku no Zushiki~
source:
Masaki's in trouble. His rich father is about to disown him. But he's still got one last chance: if he can collect on some old unpaid debts, then all will be forgiven. Masaki may be a slacker, but he's quick to realize that the fastest way to collect is to go after the debtors' daughters...

[From [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=5101]ANN[/url]]
translation:
正崎有麻烦了。他富有的父亲即将与他断绝关系。但他还有最后一次机会：如果他能收回一些未偿还的旧债，那么一切都将被免除。正木可能是个懒鬼，但他很快意识到追债最快的方法就是追债人的女儿……

[来自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=5101]ANN[/url]]
